record.label: Shared-z AQ and disjoint scale mixtures have different tails
record.summary: The common-scale Gaussian law N(m,L+sQ) is exact only for disjoint affine and quadratic blocks. Literal shared-z AQ has the additional mixed ell q^2 term at the same r^-2 order, so the centered collective-rank-one collapse does not apply to that branch.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved as a model and ownership distinction; the shared-z operator-isotropy defect remains open.
